build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with random transition and potential graphs using gen_model
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF with a given number of classes using gen_transitions
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph for a CRF with given features and classes using gen_potentials
sample_crf_data: sample training data from a linear-chain CRF model using sample_model with potentials and transitions
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF loss for a sequence pair using crf_loss with potentials and transitions graphs
